summary: Edit-before-approve / edit-before-add feature FULLY VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_edit_approve.py (approve-with-edits overrides AI, approve-without-edits uses AI, new-part POST with details persists as Unverified, duplicate part rejected 400, PATCH updates existing part, reject sets Rejected & creates NO Verified part). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): all 4 flows PASS with admin abdul/Salam@123 -> (F1) New part MANUAL-TEST-<ts> tap 'Add Details & Save NEW PART' -> modal opens -> filled name/category -> save-edit -> DETAILS card shows 'Test BCM Widget NEW'. (F2) AI edit-approve on 95400-2B000: 'Review, Edit & Approve' opens pre-filled modal, changed NAME to unique 'ADMIN-EDITED-Mirror-<n>' + vehicles 'Hyundai Creta, Kia Seltos', tap 'Approve & Save Verified' -> DETAILS card shows edited name + both vehicles + 'Verified' badge (values from admin edits, NOT raw AI). A real user can still scroll the modal, but consider bumping ScrollView maxHeight or moving Save inside the scroll region so it is always visible on small screens.
